design_detail: Progressive comprehensive wealth tax: 1% above US$1m in wealth, rising to 5% above US$1bn.
quote_original: This paper presents a framework for imposing a progressive comprehensive wealth tax in Egypt
source_title: Toward a Wealth Tax in Egypt
grading_note: The paper identifies Nader Osama as its author and specifies annual progressive rates and wealth thresholds.

design_detail: Permanent progressive wealth taxes, including at least 2% on net wealth; the report analyses Egypt.
quote_original: Impose permanent progressive taxes on wealth, with at least a permanent 2% tax on net wealth.
source_title: The Middle East and North Africa Gap: Prosperity for the rich, austerity for the rest
grading_note: Oxfam International's four-country report (Egypt, Lebanon, Morocco and Tunisia) recommends this to governments of the region. Egypt is one of the countries the report covers, but the recommendation is regional, not an Egypt-specific proposal.

design_detail: One-off global wealth tax of 10–20% on individuals with net worth above US$10m.
quote_original: He proposes a one-off global wealth tax of 10 to 20 per cent for individuals with a net worth in excess of $10m.
source_title: Egyptian businessman proposes global wealth tax
grading_note: Ahram reports Heikal's Financial Times proposal; a specific one-off wealth-tax design.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax advocated in Cairo lectures on the Middle East and Egypt.
quote_original: He called for a more transparent tax system, political integration, and a progressive wealth tax.
source_title: Thomas Piketty: The Middle East is the most unequal region; global progressive tax is necessary
grading_note: Ahram Online's account of Piketty's Cairo lecture (2 June 2016) says he called, for Egypt, for a progressive wealth tax. The words are the reporter's, not a direct quotation (his direct quotation on the page is about zakat).

design_detail: One-off or progressive wealth tax of 10–25% on wealthy Egyptians, with fortunes above US$10m discussed.
quote_original: أن تشرع السلطة وبرلمانها في إقرار ضريبة الثروة
quote_en: That the authorities and parliament should enact a wealth tax.
source_title: حان وقت فرض ضرائب الثروة على الأغنياء
grading_note: The author urges enactment in an Egypt-focused opinion article that discusses a one-off or progressive 10–25% wealth tax.

design_detail: Annual wealth tax in Egypt: 2.5–3%, beginning at EGP 10m in wealth.
quote_original: النسبة المناسبة لضريبة الثروة في مصر يمكن أن تتراوح بين 2.5% و3%
quote_en: The appropriate wealth-tax rate in Egypt could range from 2.5% to 3%.
source_title: لماذا لا تفرض مصر ضريبة على الأثرياء والثروة؟ خبراء يختلفون حول المكاسب والمخاطر
grading_note: Direct proposal with a stated Egyptian wealth-tax rate; the same article gives EGP 10m as the proposed threshold.

design_detail: Higher taxes on large fortunes as an Egyptian revenue measure.
quote_original: فرض ضرائب أعلى على الثروات الكبيرة
quote_en: Impose higher taxes on large fortunes.
source_title: لماذا لا تفرض مصر ضريبة على الأثرياء والثروة؟ خبراء يختلفون حول المكاسب والمخاطر
grading_note: Direct support for taxing large fortunes

design_detail: Called for preparation of an Egyptian wealth-tax bill.
quote_original: بضرورة تشريع قانون بشأن ضريبة لـ"الثروة" كما في دول خارجية مثل فرنسا
quote_en: That a law be legislated on a "wealth" tax, as in foreign countries such as France.
source_title: رئيس البرلمان لوزير المالية: تفعيل ضريبة الثروة ضرورة لتحقيق العدالة الاجتماعية
grading_note: Direct parliamentary proposal for a named wealth-tax bill; the article gives no tax design detail.

design_detail: Called for applying a one-off wealth tax.
quote_original: تطبيق ضريبة الثروة ولو لمرة واحدة
quote_en: Applying a wealth tax, even if only once.
source_title: رئيس البرلمان لوزير المالية: تفعيل ضريبة الثروة ضرورة لتحقيق العدالة الاجتماعية
grading_note: The Speaker's own words to the finance minister in the plenary, asking him to record the case for applying a wealth tax even once. The same article describes the tax as a temporary surcharge on high net income, so what he meant is not certain; graded B.

design_detail: One-off 1% levy on individuals' total wealth for universal health insurance.
quote_original: فرض ضريبة على الثروة "رأس المال" بقيمة 1% من إجمالى الثروة المملوكة للأشخاص
quote_en: Impose a wealth (capital) tax of 1% of individuals' total owned wealth.
source_title: نائب يقترح فرض ضريبة 1% على إجمالى ثروة الأفراد لصالح مشروع التأمين الصحى
grading_note: Direct parliamentary proposal with a one-off 1% rate applied to total individual wealth.

design_detail: Called for Parliament to study a one-off wealth-tax proposal.
quote_original: طالب النائب، بضرورة عمل البرلمان على دراسة مقترح فرض ضريبة على الثروة والتى دفع لمرة واحدة
quote_en: The MP called for Parliament to study a proposal for a wealth tax paid once.
source_title: لا حياة لمن تنادى.. نائب الغربية: "بنوصل صوت المواطن للمسئولين دون تنفيذ أى مطالب"
grading_note: Direct request for Parliament to study a named one-off wealth tax; the source gives no rate or threshold.

design_detail: One-off tax on net wealth to repay part of Egypt's public debt.
quote_original: واقترحت الدراسة فرض ضريبة على صافى الثروة لمرة واحدة تخصص لسداد جزء من الدين العام
quote_en: The study proposed a one-off tax on net wealth to repay part of the public debt.
source_title: دراسة للتخطيط القومى تقترح فرض ضريبة الثروة لمرة واحدة تخصص لسداد الدين العام
grading_note: Institutional study explicitly recommends a one-off net-wealth-tax design.

design_detail: One-off Egyptian wealth tax above US$10m in net wealth; author also proposed a recurring 2–3% version.
quote_original: إن تطبيق ضريبة ثروة لمرة واحدة لمن يتعدى ثروته 10 ملايين دولار
quote_en: Applying a one-off wealth tax to those whose wealth exceeds US$10 million.
source_title: حسن هيكل يكتب: الأغنياء.. و«وطنية ما قبل المحفظة»
grading_note: Primary signed opinion article gives a threshold and both one-off and recurring-rate designs.

design_detail: One-off 5% levy on bank-account balances above EGP 1m for the COVID-19 emergency.
quote_original: بأن تكون الضريبة ٥٪ مرة واحدة علي الحسابات التي تزيد علي مليون جنيه فقط
quote_en: The tax should be 5% once on accounts exceeding EGP 1 million only.
source_title: ضريبة الثروة ترعب الأثرياء.. هل تصلح في مصر؟
grading_note: Masr360 reports El Borai's Facebook post and reproduces its words; the post itself was not opened, so the report is the source.

design_detail: Supports implementing a net-wealth tax in Egypt.
quote_original: الفكرة جيدة ولابد من تطبيقها رغم اصطدامها بصعوبات في البداية
quote_en: The idea is good and must be implemented despite initial difficulties.
source_title: ضريبة الثروة ترعب الأثرياء.. هل تصلح في مصر؟
grading_note: Interview comment explicitly endorses the article's defined net-wealth tax but gives no rate or threshold.

design_detail: Supports a wealth tax if imposed only once in a lifetime.
quote_original: فكرة جيدة في حد ذاتها في حال ضمان تطبيقها مرة واحدة في العمر
quote_en: It is a good idea in itself if its application is guaranteed only once in a lifetime.
source_title: ضريبة الثروة ترعب الأثرياء.. هل تصلح في مصر؟
grading_note: Interview comment explicitly supports the wealth-tax proposal as a one-off levy but gives no rate or threshold.

design_detail: Says Egypt's tax system should include a substantial wealth-tax component.
quote_original: النظام الضريبي يجب أن يشمل جزءا كبيرا من الضريبة على الثروة
quote_en: The tax system should include a large component of wealth tax.
source_title: ضريبة الثروة ترعب الأثرياء.. هل تصلح في مصر؟
grading_note: Interview comment explicitly supports including a wealth tax but gives no rate or threshold.

design_detail: Temporary 5% levy on bank-account balances above EGP 1m; proceeds directed to public-service projects rather than the tax authority.
quote_original: يفرض ضرائب 5%على كل مواطن يزيد رصيده عن مليون جنيه صافٍ
quote_en: Impose 5% taxes on every citizen whose balance exceeds EGP 1 million net.
source_title: سميح ساويرس: طالبت بفرض ضرائب 5% على كل مواطن يزيد رصيده عن مليون جنيه
grading_note: Directly attributed public statement specifies a rate and threshold on a broad financial-wealth base; the report says the relevant law ran for two years.
